from django.db.models import Prefetch
from django.test import TestCase
from prefetch_related.models import Book, Author, Reader

class T(TestCase):
    def test_it(self):
        b = Book.objects.create(title="b")
        authors = [Author.objects.create(name=f"a{i}", first_book=b) for i in range(5)]
        b2 = Book.objects.create(title="b2")
        for a in authors[:3]:
            a.books.add(b, b2)
        with self.assertNumQueries(2):
            bs = list(Book.objects.order_by("id").prefetch_related(Prefetch("first_time_authors", Author.objects.order_by("-name")[1:3], to_attr="x")))
        self.assertEqual([a.name for a in bs[0].x], ["a3", "a2"])
        self.assertEqual(bs[1].x, [])
        bs = list(Book.objects.order_by("id").prefetch_related(Prefetch("authors", Author.objects.order_by("name")[:2], to_attr="x")))
        self.assertEqual([[a.name for a in x.x] for x in bs], [["a0","a1"],["a0","a1"]])
EOF
